name: Next Actualités informatiques
tagline: Check out french Next computer news (even without an Internet connection)!
blurb: Disclaimer: this application contain only news and comments in french!
description:
Disclaimer: this application contain only news and comments in french!

Read the news and comments of Next when you are connected to the Internet, and also "offline" (metro, off-grid areas, etc.) thanks to an integrated cache system!
The application manages subscribed content.
A dark theme is also present.

Unofficial application developed by a (passionate) reader of Next.
Do not hesitate to tell me your expectations!
Source code available on the application website.

If you enjoy their work, subscribe to Next to support their independence!
=> https://next.ink/subs
